HighlightsData.Title: Mission Y: Land Acquisition for Rivers - National Conference 2026
HighlightsData.Description: Mission Y is India's first national conference dedicated to establishing a scientific and policy-driven framework for land acquisition to restore small watersheds and rejuvenate rivers. The conference brings together researchers, planners, administrators, and environmental professionals to advance sustainable river management, watershed protection, and climate-resilient land-use strategies.

HighlightsData.Title: Enviro Samagam: Alumni Meet of Environmental Science and Engineering
HighlightsData.Description: Enviro Samagam is the official alumni meet of the Department of Environmental Science and Engineering, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. The event connects past and present environmental professionals to foster collaboration, mentorship, and knowledge exchange while celebrating the department's academic legacy and its role in advancing sustainable development.

HighlightsData.Title: AQMDA 2026: International Workshop on Air Quality Monitoring and Data Analysis
HighlightsData.Description: AQMDA 2026 is an international workshop focused on advancing air quality monitoring, data analytics, and evidence-based environmental decision-making. Hosted at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, the workshop brings together scientists, policymakers, and practitioners to enhance technical capacity, improve air pollution assessment, and support cleaner and healthier urban and regional environments.

EventsData.Title: The Techfest at the Society of Environmental Science and Engineering
EventsData.Description: The Techfest at the Academy of Technology is an annual event that showcases innovation and creativity in various fields of technology. It features a range of activities including workshops, competitions, exhibitions, and lectures from industry experts. Students have the opportunity to display their projects, engage in hands-on learning, and network with professionals. This event aims to inspire and cultivate a passion for technology among attendees, fostering an environment of learning and collaboration.

EventsData.Title: Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology
EventsData.Description: Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology is an annual gathering focused on gaming and e-sports. It features competitive gaming tournaments, casual gaming sessions, and interactive workshops. Participants can compete in popular games, learn about game development, and connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts. The event aims to promote the gaming culture within the academy, encouraging both fun and educational experiences in the world of video games.

EventsData.Title: The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology
EventsData.Description: The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology is a prestigious gathering that highlights the contributions of women in the field of space engineering. Esteemed IIT professors and renowned female scientists from ISRO come together to share their experiences, insights, and advancements in space technology. The event includes inspiring talks, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, aiming to encourage and empower female students to pursue careers in space engineering and related fields.

EventsData.Title: The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology
EventsData.Description: The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology is a monthly gathering hosted by the Google Developer Group. It features tech talks, coding sessions, and networking opportunities for developers to share knowledge and collaborate on projects.

CarrierAtSESEData.Title: Flexible working hours
CarrierAtSESEData.Description: Retired Professors recruited from premier institutes/ senior professionals from R & D organizations/ corporates may be considered for flexible working hours, i.e. 45 to 60 working days in a semester, @ 3 to 4 days per week considering 15 teaching weeks in a semester. Partially online teaching options may also be considered.

CarrierAtSESEData.Title: Higher scale of pay:
CarrierAtSESEData.Description: SESE provides competitive pay packages that exceed those for same positions in peer institutes. Assistant Professors with 6yrs of full time teaching/ research experience after M.Tech and registered for PhD, will be eligible for post of Assistant Professor [Senior Scale], compared to the 10yrs requirement in AICTE norms. Assistant Professors with 10yrs of full time teaching and research experience after M.Tech, already registered for PhD & with at least one publication in SCI indexed journals will be eligible for post of Assistant Professor [Selection Grade], which is highly flexible compared to AICTE norms.

CarrierAtSESEData.Title: Career development opportunity
CarrierAtSESEData.Description: Ample scope provided to engage in innovation and research in a vibrant and collaborative environment. Conducive atmosphere to develop your potential to the fullest and performance-based incentives. Mentoring by experiences academicians/ industry experts for new faculty.

CarrierAtSESEData.Title: 360 degree support for research and publication:
CarrierAtSESEData.Description: For all teaching posts, in addition to salary, incentives will be paid for career development, publication, patent, work on Govt. & industry sponsored project, attending conferences, faculty development programs, etc. as per institute norms. Dedicated research labs on Industry 4.0 technologies in the pipeline.
